description: Several errors at one place (see main.zhang): their order within the place and their ids, in the list by file and position the API answers and in the id-exact list.

known_issues.error_list: pinned, not marked wrong: a transfer's two errors come `from`, then `to` (zhang-core/src/process/budget.rs:44-47), and with both budgets undefined only `from` is reported (the `&&` at :44 stops at the first); a posting's errors at an account of several budgets come in the order of the budgets' names (the BTreeSet of zhang-core/src/ledger.rs:316); at one place a BudgetDoesNotExist (reported during the fold) comes before the BudgetCommodityMismatch errors (reported after it), whatever the order of the postings. Which place the load checks first is not pinned: the unconverted amounts are checked after the fold (report_unconverted_amounts, zhang-core/src/process/budget.rs:127, reporting at :148, called at zhang-core/src/ledger.rs:766), which no client sees, as the API orders errors by place
